note: Milestone thresholds are what the Reality-Check agent enforces. Where no authoritative source exists, the threshold is labeled 'estimate'.

habits.label: Play guitar

chapters.milestone: can play a few open chords cleanly and strum a simple song at home
plays a full easy song for friends at a small gathering
jams with another musician regularly and can pick up simple songs by ear
performs 2-3 songs at a local open mic
plays a short set at a close friend's wedding or big party
writes and performs an original song in front of an audience

sources: No single authoritative hours-to-skill source for guitar; thresholds are conservative estimates.

habits.label: Learn Spanish

chapters.milestone: orders food and asks for directions in simple Spanish
has short small-talk conversations with a Spanish-speaking neighbor
follows a Spanish TV show with Spanish subtitles
travels a week in a Spanish-speaking country handling everyday situations without a translation app
holds a real work meeting in Spanish (professional working proficiency)
chapters.basis: FSI: Spanish is Category I, about 30 weeks / 600-750 class hours of intensive training for professional working proficiency

chapters.milestone: speaks fluently and comfortably in most situations; makes close Spanish-speaking friends
chapters.basis: estimate: FSI hours are full-time classroom hours; self-study is usually slower

sources: U.S. Department of State, Foreign Service Institute, Foreign Language Training: https://www.state.gov/foreign-language-training/

habits.label: Go running

chapters.milestone: runs one mile without stopping
finishes a first 5K race
chapters.basis: NHS Couch to 5K: 9 weeks, 3 runs a week of about 30 minutes

chapters.milestone: finishes a 10K
finishes a half marathon
finishes a full marathon
is the one friends ask to start running with; leads a weekend running group

sources: CDC: adults need 150 minutes of moderate activity a week: https://www.cdc.gov/physical-activity-basics/guidelines/adults.html

habits.label: Read

chapters.milestone: finishes the first book in a long time
has a favorite author and recommends books to friends
joins or starts a book club
is known as the friend with the best book recommendations
has read 120+ books; writes thoughtful reviews people follow
has read about 200 books; reading has shaped a career or big life decision

sources: Brysbaert, M. (2019). How many words do we read per minute? Journal of Memory and Language: average silent reading 238 wpm (non-fiction).

habits.label: Save money

chapters.milestone: has a small cushion for surprise expenses
handles a $1,000 surprise bill without stress
pays cash for a dream trip
has a solid emergency fund and sleeps better
has a meaningful down-payment or career-change fund
has real financial freedom to say no to a bad job

sources: Future value of daily deposits at an assumed 4% annual return (an assumption, not financial advice).

life_events: moved to a new city for a job
had the busiest month of the year at work
went on a trip with old friends
